title: LinkGrabber

actions.enqueue_paused_hint: Add all links to the downloader without starting them

filter.facet_hint: Applies to the whole list and stays set for the next package: where a mirror group offers a choice it picks the matching mirror, elsewhere it hides what cannot match.

empty: Clipboard, Click'n'Load and manual input land here first for review. Links are checked automatically and grouped into packages.

bulk.free_download: {count} link will download without an account (free/direct) | {count} links will download without an account (free/direct)
bulk.enqueue_failed: {count} package could not be enqueued | {count} packages could not be enqueued

package.drag_hint: Drag to change the package order
package.enqueue_paused_hint: Add this package to the download list without starting it

candidate.no_account: No account – will try a free/direct download
candidate.drag_hint: Drag to change the order inside the package
candidate.duplicate_hint: This address is already in the LinkGrabber or has already been enqueued. It can deliberately be added again.
candidate.unresolvable_hint: This address answers with a page, not with a file. It cannot be added to the download list.
candidate.no_resolver_hint: No resolver is installed for {host}, so this address cannot be added to the download list. It may be a hoster this installation does not support, or a forwarder to another address.

intake.title: Add links
intake.description: Several HTTP(S) links or text with embedded links. Multipart archives are grouped into one package automatically.
intake.package_name_hint: Empty = derived from the file names
intake.skipped_excluded: No links skipped by the blocklist | {count} link skipped by the blocklist | {count} links skipped by the blocklist
intake.skipped_disabled: No links skipped by a switched-off service | {count} link skipped: its service is switched off | {count} links skipped: their service is switched off
intake.crawled_dropped: No links dropped | {count} of {found} found links was not a file and was dropped | {count} of {found} found links were not files and were dropped

nzb.enqueue_paused_hint: Add this NZB to the download list without starting it

toast.duplicate_description: “{name}” was imported before and is already waiting in the LinkGrabber.
toast.duplicate_enqueued: NZB already in the download queue
toast.duplicate_enqueued_description: “{name}” was imported before and has already been enqueued. Delete that download to import the file again.

modal.title: Import NZB, torrent or DLC
modal.description: Files land in the LinkGrabber for review; for NZBs, a {'{{'}password{'}}'} in the file name is used for extraction.
modal.drop_hint: Drop an NZB, torrent or DLC here, or choose files
modal.drop_hint_multi: Drop more NZB, torrent or DLC files here
modal.files_selected: no files selected | {count} file selected | {count} files selected
modal.name: Package name
modal.name_hint: Without .nzb/.torrent – used as the package and folder name
modal.name_single_only: Only available when a single file is selected

history.title: NZB history
history.description: All imported NZB files. Delete an entry to be able to import the same file again.
history.enqueued_hint: This import backs a download. Remove the download first, then the entry can be deleted.
history.hint: Deleting an entry allows importing the same NZB file again.

drop.title: Drop to import
drop.hint: Release NZB, torrent and DLC files anywhere to add them to the LinkGrabber.
drop.none_matched: No .nzb, .torrent or .dlc files found in the dropped items.

nzb.drag_hint: Drag to change the order in the list

files.torrent_imported_description: “{name}” is ready as a package in the LinkGrabber.
files.torrent_duplicate_description: “{name}” was marked as a duplicate and can be deliberately enqueued again.

confirm.duplicates_paused: Some links were already added. Add all packages paused anyway?
confirm.duplicates_enqueue: Some links were already added. Enqueue all packages anyway?
confirm.duplicate_description: This link was already added. Enqueue it again?
confirm.remove_selected_description: Remove no entries from the LinkGrabber? | Remove {count} entry from the LinkGrabber? | Remove {count} entries from the LinkGrabber?
confirm.remove_package_description: Remove “{name}” with all its links from the LinkGrabber?
confirm.clear_all_description: Nothing will be removed from the LinkGrabber. | {count} entry (links, NZB and torrent imports) will be removed from the LinkGrabber. | {count} entries (links, NZB and torrent imports) will be removed from the LinkGrabber.
confirm.queue_all_description: {count} hit will be queued. | {count} hits will be queued.
confirm.dismiss_all_description: {count} hit will be dismissed and never suggested again; nothing is deleted. | {count} hits will be dismissed and never suggested again; nothing is deleted.
confirm.dissolve_mirror_title: These links are not the same file?
confirm.dissolve_mirror_description: The link stays in the list; only the grouping goes. | The {count} links stay in the list; only the grouping goes. They will not be grouped together again later either.

media.merge_unavailable: Without ffmpeg and ffprobe, separate video and audio streams cannot be merged. Only formats that already carry both are offered.
media.no_match_combination: Each filter matches something on its own, but no single format satisfies all of them at once.

warnings.merge_unavailable: ffmpeg is missing, so only a pre-muxed format can be used.
warnings.codec_container_mismatch: {codec} cannot be stored in a {container} file; it will be re-encoded or the container will change.
warnings.container_unsupported: The selected container cannot hold this combination.
warnings.inventory_truncated: This page offers more formats than are shown.

media.no_inventory: This link was checked before the format selector existed. Check it again to get the full format list.

tracks.include_automatic_hint: Auto-generated subtitles come from speech recognition and are regularly wrong about names, numbers and negations. Off by default, because once embedded they look exactly like an authored translation.
tracks.automatic_only_hint: This page offers only auto-generated subtitles. Enable the option above to use them.

warnings.multiple_audio_unsupported: A {container} file cannot hold more than one audio track; the extra tracks are dropped.
warnings.subtitle_embed_unsupported: A {container} file cannot hold embedded subtitles; they are written as separate files instead.
warnings.only_automatic_available: Only an auto-generated {language} track exists. Enable auto-generated subtitles to use it.
warnings.tool_unavailable: ffmpeg is required to merge extra tracks or embed subtitles and is not available.

embed.title: Embed in the file
embed.remove_hint: Removing segments re-cuts the media. The boundaries come from a crowd-sourced database and are occasionally wrong; marking them as chapters leaves the file intact.

warnings.thumbnail_unsupported: A {container} file cannot hold a cover image; it is skipped.
warnings.chapters_unsupported: A {container} file cannot hold chapter markers; they are skipped.
warnings.source_url_withheld: The source URL carries a signature or token and is not written into the file.
warnings.tool_unavailable: ffmpeg is required to write tags or cut segments and is not available.

output.title: Output template
output.hint: Folders are separated by /. Empty keeps the plain file name.

cookies.title: Browser session
cookies.hint: Private or age-restricted pages need the session you approved for this site.
cookies.empty: No cookie profile covers this address. Add one under Settings → Authentication.

media.unresolved_title: This page offers nothing to choose from

unresolved.formats_missing: yt-dlp reported no downloadable format for this page. Check the link again; if the list stays empty, the site is not supported.
unresolved.audio_missing: The page offers video streams but not a single audio track. "Best" still downloads the video, without sound.

replay.title: Approve this download
replay.description: This download sends data your browser sent. Check what goes where before it is stored.

origins.title: Approved addresses
origins.hint: The download may only follow redirects to these addresses. Unchecking one narrows the approval.

body.title: Transmitted data
body.values_hidden: Field values are stored encrypted and are never displayed.

consent.withdraw_description: The link stays. The next time it is added, rDownloader asks again before the captured credentials are sent.

blocked.title: Cannot be reproduced
blocked.method_unsupported: This request uses an HTTP method that cannot be reproduced.
blocked.body_too_large: This request sends more data than can be stored.
blocked.file_upload: This request uploads a file, which cannot be reproduced.
blocked.multipart_unsupported: This request sends a multi-part form, which cannot be reproduced.
blocked.content_type_unsupported: This request sends a data type that cannot be reproduced.
blocked.streamed_body: The data of this request could not be read.
blocked.body_missing: The data of this request is no longer available.
blocked.expired: The address has expired and could not be renewed.
blocked.origin_not_approved: The download was redirected to an address that was not approved.
blocked.refresh_unavailable: The address expired and nothing can renew it.
blocked.contract_downgrade: This rDownloader version cannot reproduce the request.
blocked.post_resume_unsupported: The server does not support resuming this download.

enrichment.source: {name}, looked up by a plugin on {at}

notifications.intake_body: No links added. | {count} link in the LinkGrabber. | {count} links in the LinkGrabber.

indexers.title: Indexer subscriptions
indexers.hint: Hits still waiting for a decision
indexers.empty: No hit is waiting for a decision right now.
indexers.bulk_failed: {count} hit could not be handed over. | {count} hits could not be handed over.
indexers.check_all_started: Check of {count} subscription started. New hits appear here once it has finished. | Check of {count} subscriptions started. New hits appear here once they have finished.
indexers.check_all_failed: {count} check could not be started. | {count} checks could not be started.

notices.reorder_filter_active: The order can only be changed with no filter active – the hidden links would otherwise be sorted wrongly.

mirror.hint_declared: The page these links came from states that they are the same file.
mirror.hint_name_and_size: These links agreed on file name and size after the online check.
mirror.hint_name: These links only share a file name. Nothing has confirmed that they are the same file, so this grouping may be wrong.
mirror.all_offline_hint: None of the {count} mirrors answered as available. The group can still be queued; the hosters may be wrong.
mirror.use_hint: Download this mirror instead. The choice is kept and the preference no longer moves this group.
mirror.pinned_hint: You chose this mirror by hand, so the preference no longer moves this group.

cache.label: cached
cache.hint: The provider reported on {at} that it holds this file in its cache. A cache changes without notice: this is when it was measured, not a promise.
cache.hint_by: {provider} reported on {at} that it holds this file in its cache. A cache changes without notice: this is when it was measured, not a promise.

hosters.label: Show and hide hosters
hosters.hint: Hidden hosters stay in the LinkGrabber and are neither queued nor checked. As a mirror of a shown link they go along as its fallback.
